dataIdInfo.idPurp: This polyline dataset shows the attributes and location of street centerlines in the City of Kirkland.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: This polyline dataset shows the attributes and location of street centerlines in the City of Kirkland. The attribute table associated with this layer contains information such as major/minor, one-way, and public/private street flags. This dataset can also be used for address geocoding.

Consts.useLimit: This dataset is intended for general mapping purposes only. This dataset may not be used for commercial purposes.
